description: Propose a new milestone in a Chief project. By default it is created as a PROPOSAL and does nothing until a person approves it in Chief. Set queue_now only when the user asked for this task to be queued; the user will be asked to confirm. Include a clear objective and a checklist definition of done. Call list_milestones first to avoid duplicates; an open milestone with the same title is refused with duplicate_of unless allow_duplicate is true. Reuse the same idempotency_key when retrying.

allow_duplicate.description: File it even if an open milestone has the same title. Default false.

context.description: Optional background: where this came up, relevant files or links.

definition_of_done.description: Checklist items that must be true when it's done.

idempotency_key.description: A unique string for this proposal; resend the same one on retry.

objective.description: What the milestone should achieve and why.

project.description: Project id (UUID) or exact project name. Call list_projects to find it.

queue_now.description: Also approve it to run now. The user must confirm; needs milestones:approve.

title.description: Short milestone title, one line; used to spot duplicates.

name: propose_milestone
title: Propose a milestone
